title: contract opportunities - u.s. embassy in togo
paragraphs: ••note: pdf files can be viewed with adobe acrobat reader. if you do not have adobe reader, you may download the latest version. the u.s. embassy in lome, general services office (gso) contracting and procurement, seeks to enter into contracts with qualified reliable firms with sufficient resources, financing, and work experience for delivering and performing a variety of commodities and or services. in order for a company to be considered for embassy contracts, the company shall be able to meet, satisfy, understand, and comply with the requirements in the request for quotation. below are current opportunities. qualified firms interested in any of these opportunities must follow the specific instructions in the solicitation description that is provided for each opportunity.

request for quotation the u.s. embassy in lomé, togo, invites qualified vendors to submit quotations for the supply of chiller compressor parts, as detailed in the attached rfq package. the u.s. government intends to award a purchase order to the responsible offeror submitting the lowest-priced, acceptable quotation. award may be made based on initial quotations without discussions; however, the government reserves the right to hold discussions with offerors in the competitive range if necessary. interested vendors are encouraged to review the full rfq package for complete specifications, part numbers, and quantities prior to submitting a quotation. request for quotation letter due date:  august 28, 2026, 16:30 gmt
